summary: Manual extraction for rakudai-kishi-main vol-10. The volume resolves the Amane/Shizuku cliffhanger and covers the Seven Stars semifinals. Shizuku, driven by regret over failing to protect Ikki in childhood, chooses an illegal pre-match ambush on Amane, with Alice becoming her accomplice rather than leaving her alone. The plan exploits a loophole in Nameless Glory, but Amane's causality survives the perfect attack, disables Alice, defeats Shizuku, and publicly distorts her feelings until Stella breaks in and protects Shizuku's dignity. That night Ikki refines Edelweiss-style body control while Stella demonstrates her new strength; Tsukikage then secretly gives Ikki Amane's original identity and traumatic past. In the first semifinal, Stella and Ouma clash as A-rank monsters: Ouma reveals his self-imposed Heavenly Dragon Armor evolution after losing to Tyrant, but Stella awakens the truth of her power as the mythic Dragon concept and defeats him with Katharterio Salamandra. Before the second semifinal Ikki thanks Shizuku and carries her will. Amane first tries to forfeit so his announced support will taint the promised Ikki-Stella final, but Ikki exposes his self-pity as Amamiya Shion and draws him into battle. Ikki's embodied sword mastery overcomes luck-induced mistakes and even a stopped heart, defeating Amane without using Ittou Shura during the official match. Amane then loses control, concentrating his causality into black death hands; Ikki uses Ittou Shura to subdue him and offers Ryoma's lesson that regret proves one has not abandoned oneself. A hidden graze leaves Ikki dying from the death result, but Kiriko arrives and saves him, repaying Amane for her forced first-round withdrawal. Ikki wakes after the scheduled final day, believes he has failed Stella, then finds Stella, the audience, and the committee waiting; Kaieda reschedules the Ikki-Stella final for the next evening.
